description: This source file defines the core module for building optimized GIFs tailored for Slack, including functionalities for frame management, color optimization, deduplication, and final GIF saving.

classes.name: GIFBuilder
classes.description: Builder class for creating, optimizing, and saving animated GIFs optimized for Slack.

methods.name: __init__(self, width: int = 480, height: int = 480, fps: int = 15)
methods.description: Initializes the GIFBuilder with specified dimensions and fps.

methods.name: add_frame(self, frame: np.ndarray | Image.Image)
methods.description: Adds a single frame to the GIF, converting if necessary and resizing to specified dimensions.

methods.name: add_frames(self, frames: list[np.ndarray | Image.Image])
methods.description: Adds multiple frames to the GIF.

methods.name: list[np.ndarray] optimize_colors( self, num_colors: int = 128, use_global_palette: bool = True )
methods.description: Reduces the number of colors in all frames using quantization, with optional global palette for better compression.

methods.name: int deduplicate_frames(self, threshold: float = 0.9995)
methods.description: Removes nearly identical consecutive frames based on a similarity threshold.

methods.name: dict save( self, output_path: str | Path, num_colors: int = 128, optimize_for_emoji: bool = False, remove_duplicates: bool = False, )
methods.description: Outputs the constructed frames as an optimized GIF file suitable for Slack, with options for emoji optimization and duplication removal.

methods.name: clear(self)
methods.description: Clears all stored frames to reset the builder.
